verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere ships an official CLI, Wally, with GitHub releases. Its docs cover browser-based sign-in that hands a credential to the terminal, `wally account whoami`/`usage` commands, one-command pointing of tools at a model, and the same CLI running small models offline without an account. Community hands-on reports cover a separate RunAnywhere CLI, rcli, with segfaults and install problems, which weakens confidence but does not contradict the documented Wally CLI. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the Wally CLI, a full command reference beyond account/auth/run basics, and evidence of reliable installation given the rcli failure reports.
